text:
maria: quick update — I enabled the console soft-rollforward for v2 routing at 5% (console.flag.v2_routing=true). want to catch any quota/latency regressions early.

josh: ack. which cohorts get rolled? small tenants only?

maria: yep — cohort=shadow-small-tenants, exclude enterprise and dedicated. goal is to validate routing charm without changing billing.

sam: curious about quota math — if v2 routing changes backend affinity we might see token burst to new endpoints and bump committed throughput. have we set a burst cap?

maria: good call. I set per-token burst ceiling to 2x on the v2 path and enabled soft-throttling in gauge. no hard caps yet.

deploy-bot: flag update: console.flag.v2_routing=true applied to cohort shadow-small-tenants at 2024-05-22T14:05:00Z. rollout=5%.

josh: can analytics add per-route token delta + 95p latency for those tenants? want alerts if token delta > 15% or p95 latency +50ms.

analytics-bot: will start an adhoc query every 1m for cohort=shadow-small-tenants. alert thresholds: token_delta_pct>15, p95_latency_incr_ms>50. will post summaries to #eng-platform-alerts.

sam: also add cache-hit-rate and KV-cache-warmup metric. v2 has a different prefix behavior; cold-kv misses could cause burst.

maria: added cache-hit-rate and kv-cold-miss-rate. also added a sampling probe to log a pair of requests (v1 vs v2) for manual diffing.

josh: how are we surfacing this in console? customers might see a compatibility badge. we should avoid alarming small tenants.

maria: console shows a subtle "Opt-in routing experiment" badge in tenant UI. no emails. admin-level toast only.

sam: telemetry gap hypothesis: dashboards currently aggregate by model and region, not by routing variant. analytics-bot — can you tag event stream with routing_variant?

analytics-bot: yep — adding tag `routing_variant` to request events. will backfill 6h of logs for baseline.

josh: if we see request shape differences (longer sequences => different batching) we might need to adjust quota mapping. who owns that?

maria: quota mapping owned by infra/quota-service. pinging @sam to coordinate a fast mapping change if needed.

sam: will prep a mapping that maps v2 route -> quota-group v1-equivalent with a 0.9 scaling factor as a safe initial roll.

josh: good. one more: if we detect more than 3 tenants with >20% error increase, auto-disable flag for that tenant. is that in the plan?

maria: yes — automatic per-tenant rollback rule implemented: error_incr_pct>20 for 5m -> revert flag for that tenant. also log an operator ticket.

analytics-bot: first 10m summary (cohort=shadow-small-tenants): token_delta=+3.2%, p95_latency=+12ms, kv_cold_miss_rate=0.9%. no error spikes.

sam: nice. keep sampling enabled for another hour. I want to inspect KV warmup traces offline.

josh: likewise, I'll watch billing projections. if forward traffic shows >10% token growth extrapolated to monthly, we'll throttle the rollout.

maria: thanks team. next check-in in 30m. please drop quick notes in this thread if you see anything odd. :thumbsup:
